user.title: Connect to Portland General Electric
user.description: Sign in with the PGE account email and password. MFA-enabled accounts are not supported.

credential.title: PGE email and password
credential.description: Enter the PGE login and the account number for this entry. The same email/password can be used for multiple entries with different account numbers. MFA-enabled accounts are not supported.

reauth_credential.title: Reauthenticate with PGE
reauth_credential.description: Enter your PGE email and password. MFA accounts are unsupported. Account number stays fixed for this entry.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to PGE API
error.mfa_unsupported: This PGE account requires MFA, which is not supported
error.captcha_unsupported: PGE login requires CAPTCHA/device challenge, which is not supported
error.discovery_incomplete: Email/password login is not ready yet — MFA/CAPTCHA accounts are unsupported; retry with a non-MFA PGE login
error.no_accounts: No PGE accounts were discovered for this login
error.account_not_found: That account number was not found for this login. Check the number, or add a separate entry with different credentials.

abort.already_configured: This PGE account is already configured

manual_sync.title: Manual sync
manual_sync.description: Start a one-off sync. **Refresh now** re-fetches the correction window. **Backfill missing history** uses your current Sync settings history bounds (Full history or From start date). Progress appears on the PGE device page — {link}

data_description.manual_sync_action: Choose refresh (recent days) or backfill (missing history from Sync settings).

settings.title: Sync settings
settings.description: Control polling, history depth, and automatic tiered backfill (hourly → daily → monthly).

data_description.polling_interval: How often to refresh recent usage. Default is every 4 hours on the Pacific clock grid.
data_description.polling_interval_unit: Unit for the polling interval (minutes, hours, or days). Default is hours.
data_description.sync_local_time: America/Los_Angeles clock that anchors hour- and day-unit schedules (default midnight). Example: every 4 hours from 12:00 AM → 12am, 4am, 8am, noon, 4pm, 8pm. Ignored for minutes.
data_description.correction_window: Closed days re-fetched each poll for estimated→actual corrections.
data_description.history_mode: Full history from 2019-01-01, or from a chosen start date.
data_description.history_start_date: Used when history mode is From start date (YYYY-MM-DD).
data_description.hourly_backfill_days: Newest days fetched at hourly resolution before falling back to daily.
data_description.auto_backfill: When enabled, missing history is backfilled after setup or options changes.
data_description.include_cost: Import USD cost alongside kWh into Energy statistics.
data_description.include_diagnostics: Expose auth expiration and last API error sensors.
data_description.include_billing: Import account balance, bill/payment history, and program enrollment as sensors, binary sensors, and long-term statistics.
data_description.backfill_concurrency: Parallel day fetches for the hourly tier (1–4).

credentials.title: Update PGE credentials
credentials.description: Account {account_id} stays fixed. Email/password renew auth only; statistic IDs are unchanged. {password_status}

data_description.password: When a password is already saved, this field is pre-filled (masked). Use the eye icon to reveal it.
